input: Research electric bike models within my commuting budget

gold.taskTitle: Research Electric Bike Models Within Commuting Budget
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate electric bike models that fit the user's budget and commuting needs.

questions.title: What is your exact budget for the electric bike?
questions.description: Understand the specific dollar amount or range the user is willing to spend.

questions.title: How long is your typical daily commute in miles?
questions.description: Determine the commute distance to assess battery range requirements.

questions.title: What type of terrain will you be riding on?
questions.description: Identify whether the route is flat, hilly, mixed, or off-road to narrow down suitable models.

questions.title: Will the bike be stored indoors or outdoors at destinations?
questions.description: Clarify storage conditions to factor in portability, folding capability, or lock requirements.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred style of bike frame?
questions.description: Determine if the user prefers a specific style such as step-through, mountain, hybrid, or folding.

questions.title: Are there specific features you consider non-negotiable?
questions.description: Identify must-have features such as throttle assist, pedal assist levels, integrated lights, or cargo rack.

questions.title: Where do you plan to buy, online or local shops?
questions.description: Understand the preferred purchasing channel to tailor research toward available retailers or brands.
